name: Baby Scamp Swarm
source: Pathfinder Society Quest #22: Friends in Need

generalAbilities.name: Elemental Draw
generalAbilities.description: The baby scamp swarm can sense creatures with a connection to the elements. It is drawn to creatures that have cast an elemental spell or used an elemental ability within the last round.

defensiveAbilities.name: Elemental Conduit
defensiveAbilities.description: A creature within the swarm's space that casts an elemental spell or uses an elemental ability does not need to make a flat check. Additionally, the baby scamps empower their spell causing the save DC to be 1 higher.

offensiveAbilities.name: We're Helping!
offensiveAbilities.description:
The Young scamps all try to help the creatures in their space at the same time. Each creature must attempt a type:will|dc:15 save.

Critical Success The creature is affected as if Guidance had been cast on them.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature is Fascinated until the end of their next turn.

offensiveAbilities.name: Wing Buffet
offensiveAbilities.description: Each creature within the baby scamp swarm's space takes 2d4 Bludgeoning Damage damage (type:reflex|dc:15|basic:true save).
